scope: Source-grounded interpretation rules, not an observation of the hidden cause

findings: cpu_handle_interrupt consumes CPU_INTERRUPT_DEBUG into EXCP_DEBUG before a subsequent TB dispatch; SSTEP_NOIRQ does not mask CPU_INTERRUPT_DEBUG.
cpu_loop_exec_tb and the atomic-step path emit trace_exec_tb before cpu_tb_exec enters generated guest code.
cpu_tb_exec emits trace_exec_tb_exit after tcg_qemu_tb_exec returns; flags greater than TB_EXIT_IDX1 mean that TB did not start. Longjmp paths need not emit that exit event.
TB dispatch alone is not proof of guest instruction retirement. Missing TB exit alone cannot establish non-retirement.
A complete, enabled, correctly ordered interval with no TB entry constrains execution more strongly than bare T05; it does not uniquely identify pending DEBUG.
Debugger connection initializes c_cpu and g_cpu to the first attached CPU; system-mode GDB CPU index is CPUState cpu_index plus one.
A watch stop clears watchpoint_hit after constructing the stop packet; bare T05 does not expose pending-debug state.
The stop callback emits its stop reply before disabling single-step. A following processed read request is an ordering witness after that callback.
Unaddressed native s enables CPUState single-step and continues; no guest PC/register write is required.
qC reports the first thread of the current process, not independent equality of both debugger CPU selectors.
qqemu.sstepbits and qqemu.sstep query supported/default modes; setters remain outside the diagnostic policy.
The log backend emits enabled events through qemu_log; timestamp mode adds host thread ID and wall-clock timestamp.
A shared log stream is locked for each qemu_log call and flushed before unlocking; the diagnostic does not select per-thread or lossy ring-buffer logging.
query-cpus-fast exposes vCPU index, target, QOM path and host thread ID, not instruction-retirement or internal pending-debug state.
Trace event state queries distinguish enabled, disabled and unavailable. Only exact exec_tb/exec_tb_exit dynamic logging-state changes are admitted by this wrapper.

installed_host_capability.observed_static_support: qemu-system-x86_64 -trace help lists all selected events; the binary contains their log-backend format strings.
installed_host_capability.source_ceiling: Upstream v8.2.2 paths are inspected; exact Ubuntu patched source is not independently reconstructed. Runtime positive trace-health witnesses are still required.
installed_host_capability.debugger_prerequisite: No installed gdb/gdb-multiarch or matching local build-ID DWARF found; no debugger attached, package installed or host memory/register instrumentation performed.

forbidden_inferences: No trace entry alone does not prove a specific pending-debug cause.
TB entry or translation is not an instruction-retirement counter.
Metadata, trace-health failure or non-reproduction cannot authorize another candidate attempt or drain step.
This diagnostic never qualifies full-workload memory, historical runtime equivalence, RSS, exact stack/kernel-stack peak, canonical promotion or containment release.
